items.text: Baltimore (early week): QB Lamar Jackson (thumb) on IR, Week 16 earliest; Jacoby Brissett starts. CB Marlon Humphrey (team discipline) availability TBD. Missed last game - DL Nnamdi Madubuike (hamstring), S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee). IR - C Ethan Pocic, K Tyler Loop. Derrick Henry evaluated for concussion late vs CAR, said he felt fine.

Houston (early week): DE Danielle Hunter (hamstring) missed 2 games, less likely to play; RB Woody Marks (concussion) trending to return. WR Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring), G Wyatt Teller (back) out last game. IR - LB Azeez Al-Shaair. C.J. Stroud starts.
